games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: Dead puck: if nobody's stick touches a loose puck for 5 seconds, the whistle blows and there's a faceoff at the nearest dot
Puck loses about 20% of its speed every time it bounces off the boards, posts or crossbar (shots off the stick are just as hard as before)
Body checks can knock a loose puck forward the way the checker was moving (about half the time)
Scrambles: when both teams reach a loose puck at the same moment it sometimes pops straight up, bounces off the dome and lands wherever it lands - nobody can touch it until it drops
